data.name: Nikunj
data.gender_notes: Nikunj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nikunj is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Nikunj’ which means ‘young one’ or a ‘delightful place’. This name is often associated with Lord Krishna, who is known to have spent his childhood in a grove, a Nikunj. It represents joy, happiness, and the innocence of childhood. The name Nikunj carries the meaning “Young One, Delight, Joy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nikunj usually hope their child will grow to embody young one, delight, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes the joy and innocence of Lord Krishna.
data.etymology: Nikunj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Young One, Delight, Joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nikunj total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
